en.title: Connection health
en.description: What each connected account can really do right now.
en.liveNote: This page doesn’t contact the platforms. It shows Rafii’s last verified records. To check an account now, open Channels and choose Re-verify.
en.unavailable: Connection health isn’t available for this workspace yet.
en.stateLine.ready: Publishing and analytics both work for this account.
en.stateLine.limited: Some features work. The ones that don’t are listed below.
en.stateLine.authorized: Permissions are granted, but nothing is usable yet.
en.stateLine.syncing: Rafii is importing this account’s data now.
en.stateLine.connected: Only the account is linked. Rafii can’t read its data or publish yet.
en.stateLine.expired: Rafii can’t use this account until you reconnect it.
en.stateLine.blocked: Rafii can’t use this account right now. Reconnecting won’t change that.
en.stateLine.unsupported: Rafii can’t connect to this platform yet.
en.reason.reconnect_required: Reconnect once to enable secure background access. Your grant wasn’t classified as revoked.
en.reason.account_only: Only the account is linked: no data or publishing permission.
en.reason.sync_failed: The last data read didn’t finish.
en.reason.platform_unavailable: This platform isn’t available in Rafii right now.
en.reason.operator_paused: Rafii has paused this platform for now.
en.reason.youtube_policy_review: Review and agree to the current YouTube policies before Rafii uses YouTube for you.
en.reason.youtube_policy_unavailable: YouTube access is unavailable until the published policies are ready.
en.reason.publishing_off: Publishing isn’t switched on in Rafii yet, so posts are prepared as drafts.
en.reason.demo_account: This is a demo account, so nothing is really published.
en.status.publishing.private_only: Uploads stay private until Google completes its audit of Rafii.
en.status.publishing.assisted: Rafii prepares the post; you publish it yourself.
en.status.publishing.assisted_review: Rafii prepares the post; you publish it yourself until {platform} approves Rafii’s publishing.
en.status.analytics.available: Rafii reads analytics for this account’s posts.
en.status.analytics.on_request: Read when you open it in Rafii. Not collected in the background.
en.status.history.on_request: Rafii can read the past posts you choose.
en.status.comments.available: Rafii reads comments on this account’s posts.
en.status.comments.on_request: Read when you open it in Rafii.
en.status.not_collected: Permission granted, but Rafii doesn’t read this for {platform} here yet.
en.status.not_enabled: Permission granted, but it isn’t switched on for this account yet.
en.status.unavailable: Unavailable until this account works again.
en.status.on_request: Available when you open it in Rafii.
en.status.assisted: You finish the last step yourself.
en.lastSyncNone: Nothing to read in the background for this account
en.manageRequired: Ask an owner or admin to reconnect this account.
en.reconnectUnavailable: Reconnect isn’t available for {platform} right now.
en.reconnectNote: Reconnecting uses {platform}’s own sign-in. Rafii never changes an account’s permissions without it.
en.autonomyToday: Rafii works as it does today, with each page’s own confirmations.
en.autonomyConnections: Rafii’s agent can’t connect, reconnect or disconnect accounts for you. That always happens here, through each platform’s own sign-in.
en.autonomyShadow: Preview: these choices are saved but not enforced yet.
en.autonomyNeedsChoice: You haven’t chosen agent permissions yet.
en.autonomyUnavailable: Agent permissions couldn’t be read right now.

zh-Hant.title: 連線狀態
zh-Hant.description: 每個已連線帳戶目前實際可以做到甚麼。
zh-Hant.liveNote: 這個頁面不會聯絡各平台，只顯示 Rafii 最後一次核實的紀錄。如要即時檢查帳戶，請到「頻道」選擇「重新核實」。
zh-Hant.unavailable: 這個工作區暫時未能使用連線狀態。
zh-Hant.panelSummary: {ready} 個就緒 · {limited} 個受限 · {attention} 個需要處理
zh-Hant.stateLine.ready: 這個帳戶的發佈和分析數據都可以正常運作。
zh-Hant.stateLine.limited: 部分功能可以使用，未能使用的功能列在下方。
zh-Hant.stateLine.authorized: 權限已授予，但暫時沒有可以使用的功能。
zh-Hant.stateLine.syncing: Rafii 正在匯入這個帳戶的資料。
zh-Hant.stateLine.connected: 只連結了帳戶本身，Rafii 暫時未能讀取資料或發佈。
zh-Hant.stateLine.expired: 重新連線之前，Rafii 無法使用這個帳戶。
zh-Hant.stateLine.blocked: Rafii 目前無法使用這個帳戶，重新連線也不會改變。
zh-Hant.stateLine.unsupported: Rafii 暫時未能連線到這個平台。
zh-Hant.reason.reconnect_required: 請重新連線一次，以啟用安全的背景存取。你的授權並未被判定為已撤銷。
zh-Hant.reason.account_only: 只連結了帳戶本身，沒有資料或發佈權限。
zh-Hant.reason.sync_failed: 上一次讀取資料未能完成。
zh-Hant.reason.platform_unavailable: Rafii 目前未能使用這個平台。
zh-Hant.reason.youtube_policy_review: Rafii 代你使用 YouTube 之前，請先查看並同意最新的 YouTube 政策。
zh-Hant.reason.youtube_policy_unavailable: 已發佈的政策準備好之前，暫時無法使用 YouTube。
zh-Hant.reason.publishing_off: Rafii 尚未開啟發佈，帖子會先準備成草稿。
zh-Hant.reason.demo_account: 這是示範帳戶，不會真正發佈任何內容。
zh-Hant.status.publishing.private_only: Google 完成對 Rafii 的審核之前，上載的影片會保持私人。
zh-Hant.status.publishing.assisted: Rafii 會準備好帖子，由你自己發佈。
zh-Hant.status.publishing.assisted_review: {platform} 批准 Rafii 發佈之前，Rafii 會準備好帖子，由你自己發佈。
zh-Hant.status.analytics.available: Rafii 會讀取這個帳戶帖子的分析數據。
zh-Hant.status.analytics.on_request: 在 Rafii 打開時才讀取，不會在背景收集。
zh-Hant.status.history.on_request: Rafii 可以讀取你選擇的過往帖子。
zh-Hant.status.comments.available: Rafii 會讀取這個帳戶帖子的留言。
zh-Hant.status.comments.on_request: 在 Rafii 打開時才讀取。
zh-Hant.status.not_collected: 權限已授予，但 Rafii 暫時未有在這裏讀取 {platform} 的這項資料。
zh-Hant.status.awaiting_review: 正在等待 {platform} 批准 Rafii。
zh-Hant.status.not_enabled: 權限已授予，但這個帳戶暫時未啟用這項功能。
zh-Hant.status.unavailable: 帳戶恢復運作之前暫時無法使用。
zh-Hant.status.on_request: 在 Rafii 打開時可以使用。
zh-Hant.status.assisted: 最後一步由你自己完成。
zh-Hant.lastSync.history_import: 上一次匯入過往分析數據：{when}
zh-Hant.lastSyncUnknown: 不清楚上一次讀取時間
zh-Hant.lastSyncNone: 這個帳戶沒有需要在背景讀取的資料
zh-Hant.lastProblem: 之後有一次讀取未能完成（{when}）。
zh-Hant.manageRequired: 請聯絡擁有者或管理員重新連線這個帳戶。
zh-Hant.reconnectNote: 重新連線會使用 {platform} 本身的登入流程。沒有這個步驟，Rafii 絕不會更改帳戶的權限。
zh-Hant.autonomyToday: Rafii 會照現時的方式運作，每個頁面保留各自的確認步驟。
zh-Hant.autonomyConnections: Rafii 助理不能代你連線、重新連線或中斷連線帳戶。這些操作一律在這裏，透過各平台本身的登入流程完成。
zh-Hant.autonomyShadow: 預覽：這些選擇已儲存，但暫時未會執行。
zh-Hant.autonomyUnavailable: 暫時未能讀取助理權限。
